# Generated branch — do not edit here

This branch is the built site. GitHub Pages serves it at
<https://lepanegossi.github.io/the-24-hour-human/>.

The source lives on `redesign-visuals`, under `the-24-hour-human/`:
`build_dashboard.py` writes `dashboard.html`, and `publish.sh` copies the folder
to the root of this branch with `dashboard.html` renamed to `index.html`.

Anything edited here is overwritten by the next publish.
